en-us.exp_event_erav_house_small_apron_ongoing: Aproned, $names$ cleans the whole house, on call throughout.
en-us.exp_event_erav_house_small_apron_result_: Bending to scrub, her skirt catches the draft; a passing man of the house flips it back down for her, the way one straightens a leaning houseplant.
Reaching for the drying pole with the bedding, she is steadied by a passing hand - which takes the chance to tour beneath the apron, then leaves as if nothing had happened.
Carrying tea down the corridor, she is stopped for a refill. By the time the tea is poured, a hand has settled on her shoulder with no intention of moving.
en-us.exp_event_erav_house_small_son_call_ongo: The youngest son's shout carries from the game room, calling $names$ in.
en-us.exp_event_erav_house_small_son_call_resu: The youngest son wants someone kneeling beside him while he games, mouth occupied. $names$ serves him through a whole match - twenty-five minutes. "Don't move. Move and I lose."
en-us.exp_event_erav_house_small_night_bath_on: The bathhouse lights are still on; tonight is $names$'s shift.
en-us.exp_event_erav_house_small_night_bath_re: $names$ draws the late master's bath, and the hand testing the water temperature is held in it a while longer. "Test it again. Still hot."
In the bathhouse she is idly put to scrubbing backs and handing towels. By the end, the day's bath counts as seen to.
en-us.exp_event_erav_house_small_housekeeper_o: The housekeeper summons $names$ to the side hall and looks her over the way one hands over household accounts.
en-us.exp_event_erav_house_small_housekeeper_r: The housekeeper circles $names$, straightens her apron strings, brushes dust from her skirt. "You are this house's face. Guests tomorrow - don't shame it."
The housekeeper runs the routine check over $names$'s knees and between her legs, frowning, and notes two items. "Salve's in the cabinet. See to it yourself. ...Now take in the bedding."
